tool_calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original CH03 Lumi transparent combat source sheet A, direction S.
Input image1 (portrait) is ONLY identity/costume reference: omit pet/background. Input image2(E sheetA) is ONLY anatomy scale/painterly quality reference; draw a genuinely NEW camera/body yaw below, not the reference's east view.
Request native2048x2048 genuine transparent PNG. Tool if delivers1254x1254 keep native1254 without upscale. Exactly4 distinct whole sprites in2x2 equal cells (TL/TR/BL/BR), isolated with no grid/no text. Keep each figure a little smaller than reference so all hat/staff/dress/boots fit with at least35px fully transparent border in every cell, including outer edges and middle dividing gutters. Entire sprite target550px high at actual1254; anatomy top-of-HAIR excluding hat to average BOOT contact450-500real px. Use compact but broad witchhat and compact staff crown so body doesn't shrink. All4 poses same adult anatomy standing scale.
Subject:22yo adult woman Lumi. Full bust fully contained by fitted dress bodice, explicit narrow waist and slender shoulders/arms/calves, proportionate curvy not thick/fat/chibi. Chestnut brown curly hair. Obsidian black/midnight-purple broad witchhat and tailored cinched-waist mid-length layered dress with silver arcane crescent embroidery, black crescent boots. Tall ornate black/silver huge star-ring/crescent staff, violet crystal with CONTAINED ghostblue light. Retain portrait identity but combat-readable garment silhouette. Do not draw pet.
Style: warm lit volumetric hand-painted premium cartoon fantasy, high camera oblique near-isometric2.5D, dimensional paint, clear dark clothes with warm highlights/silver trim. Adult proportion.
DIRECTION S IN ALL4 SPRITES: heading90 degrees clockwise from screen right, straight DOWN towards viewer. True FRONT view at elevated oblique camera: BOTH eyes and symmetrical shoulders/chest, nose aligned center, knees and both boot toes point straight down to bottom of screen. Hat top visible. No sideways3/4 turn. This exact front-body angle is SOUTH. REPAINT actual face/torso/arms/hat/legs/boot orientation and asymmetric clothing at this yaw. Do not mirror or rotate an entire existing sprite. Each pose's face/chest/knees/toes agrees with this direction. This is one exact direction shared by all4.
TOP LEFT idle: relaxed stable balanced feet, staff SIDE-upright in one hand (not obscuring face), free hand lowered.
TOP RIGHT walk_left: left leg steps forward ALONG S and right leg back; two boots clearly separated and visible below skirt, natural opposite arm/body shift, staff carried side-upright.
BOTTOM LEFT walk_right: reverse phase: right leg steps forward ALONG S and left leg back, both boots visible and separated. Not duplicate same leg.
BOTTOM RIGHT basic_windup: stable feet, free hand lightly raised to chest to prepare commanding unseen pet, staff remains side-upright, no face obstruction.
Avoid southeast/southwest45° masquerading as30°/60°, same east angle, whole-body rotation/mirroring, male engineer/beard, cream/pink/pastel-lilac/teal identity, fat limbs, sexual pose/cleavage, huge hat body shrinking, pet/companion/Tuantuan, detached effects/stray transparent confetti, trail, floor, ground/contact shadow, colored/white opaque background, text/labels/grid/watermark. Exactly FOUR nonoverlapping complete sprites with genuine transparent margins.

landmark_annotation.coordinate_space: Original native1254x1254 PNG, x right and y down; no cropping/scaling/packing performed.
landmark_annotation.method: Manual visual annotation of face center, hand grip, top tip of glowing central violet crystal, visible hair top excluding hat, and mean of two sole-contact center points. Pillow/numpy used only read-measure alpha and connected components. Error bounds are estimates, not calibrated certainty.
landmark_annotation.foot_definition: Arithmetic mean of TWO boot sole-contact centers; rear sole obscured by skirt explicitly estimated.
landmark_annotation.hair_definition: Visible top of chestnut hair below brim; hat and staff excluded. Occluded hair/sole locations are visual estimates.
landmark_annotation.muzzle_definition: Top visible tip of glowing central violet staff crystal, excluding silver crown point; manually estimated.
landmark_annotation.normalization: None. Runtime processor must use one fixed direction idle reference for all poses and preserve crouch height; do not enlarge each dash/guard pose to standing height.

visual_review.handedness: Anatomical left staff/right free command; guard two hands.

pending_checks: Built-in tool returned native1254square; native2K requirement not met, no upscale applied.
Some full silhouettes cross invisible cell bounds or have less than35px margin. Four characters are separate connected components but rectangular bboxes can contain neighbor pixels.

Runtime processor must separate connected components with manual head/foot/grip seeds, retain same-body staff/hat detail and clean only measured low-alpha external noise under user-authorized local frame processing.
Direction-wide fixed idle scale/anchor review and complete12-direction family review required before production.
notes: Original raw output copied without software editing. Wrong-direction and multi-arm rejected intermediates remain only CODEX generated_images. No portrait, previous basic source, loader, manifest, tools code, Godot execution, or commit changed.
